title: Engineering Behavioral Fidelity in LLM Agents for Economic Simulations
relationship_summary: Equal-weight mean of non-missing cohort metrics within each condition, matching the final analysis. Formation rate is undefined when a cohort has no previously inactive ties: five baseline cohorts and four single-call cohorts contribute to that column. Only condition-level aggregates are included.
scope: Aggregate results, newly written visualization code and a protocol schedule demonstration. No manuscript, participant records, original simulator source, raw model logs or credentials.

architecture_reference.role: Architectural precedent for memory, reflection, and planning; adapted for the repeated game

acknowledgments.name: Daniel Kral
acknowledgments.contribution: Thesis supervision and starting code for the experiments
